name: oh-my-hermes
description: All in one plugin for Hermes Agent ⚚ the coding intelligence, a long-term memory system and model optimized workflow packages
one_liner: A plugin pack for the Hermes coding-AI agent that gives it a long-term memory, so it stops forgetting your project every time you close it.
buyer: An individual developer already using the Hermes coding agent who is frustrated it forgets context between sessions.
business_use_cases: A solo developer installs it to keep a persistent project memory across coding sessions instead of re-explaining context each time.
A small dev team shares curated memory/config templates tuned for their specific codebase conventions.

money_ideas.idea: Sell premium, pre-tuned memory and workflow templates for specific tech stacks (e.g. a Django-tuned pack).

steal_this: A niche plugin for a specific AI agent's existing user base — not a standalone weekend business, but a good candidate for a $10 template pack sold to that community.
